note: Edit this file to add, remove or change courses. The Learn page reads it live, so no HTML changes are needed. Set added to the date you add a course; entries added within the last 30 days show a NEW badge automatically.

courses.title: Learn 95% of ChatGPT work in under 20 minutes
courses.gain: Practical prompting for actual work rather than novelty tricks: drafting, summarising, reformatting and cleaning up your own writing. The most useful twenty minutes on this list for admin work.

courses.title: Create 30 days of content in under 60 minutes
courses.gain: Batching a month of social content in one session. This is the workflow a social media VA is hired to run, and doing it in a batch is what makes the work profitable.

courses.title: Manage a client's email like a pro
courses.gain: Built for VAs specifically, not for executives managing their own inbox. Labels, filters, priorities and what to escalate versus handle yourself.

courses.title: Calendar management course for virtual assistants
courses.gain: Step by step calendar management from a VA trainer: scheduling across time zones, handling conflicts, and protecting a client's focus time. Same instructor as the email video above.

courses.title: CapCut Tutorial for Beginners, full editing guide
courses.gain: Layout, trimming, transitions, captions, filters and audio in one pass. CapCut is free and is what most clients mean when they ask for short-form edits.

courses.title: QuickBooks Online training playlist
courses.gain: A structured series rather than scattered clips, working through QuickBooks Online from account setup onward. Pair it with Hector Garcia's channel when you need a specific feature explained.

courses.title: QuickBooks Online 2026 full tutorial
courses.gain: A working CPA walking through the current QuickBooks Online in one sitting. His older tutorials have far more views but are built on the 2019 interface, which has since moved on.

courses.title: Get started in QuickBooks Online, quick tour
courses.gain: Four minutes to get oriented before you commit to anything longer. Watch this first, then Hector Garcia's full tutorial.

courses.provider: YouTube / Technology for Teachers and Students
courses.title: Google Sheets for Beginners, the complete course
courses.gain: A full Sheets course in under an hour: formulas, formatting, sorting, filtering and charts. Spreadsheets are the most requested VA skill and the one most people fake.

courses.title: How to use Google Drive, beginner tutorial
courses.gain: Folders, sharing, permissions and search. Getting a client's Drive organised is often the first thing you are handed, and doing it badly is very visible.

courses.title: How to use Google Docs, beginner tutorial
courses.gain: Formatting, comments, suggesting mode, templates and sharing. Suggesting mode in particular is how you edit a client's document without overwriting their work.

courses.title: How to use Google Calendar, beginner tutorial
courses.gain: Multiple calendars, invites, availability and time zones. Calendar work is the least glamorous and most trusted thing an assistant does.

courses.title: Build a Notion task manager you will actually use
courses.gain: A full build rather than a tour, so you finish with a working system instead of notes. Chosen over his older databases course because Notion's interface has changed enough to trip up a beginner following along.

courses.title: Canva Tutorial for Beginners, full walkthrough
courses.gain: One sitting takes you from opening Canva to building client graphics: templates, brand kit, text, backgrounds and exporting. Watch it once with Canva open in another tab and follow along.

courses.title: The official Shopify tutorial for beginners
courses.gain: Shopify's own walkthrough of setting up and running a store: products, orders, fulfilment and admin. This is what an eCommerce VA is actually asked to do.

courses.title: Clean up a Gmail inbox fast
courses.gain: Eight minutes on bulk-clearing a neglected inbox. Use this first on a messy client account, then set up a system with the email management video.

courses.title: How to price your work, full whiteboard session
courses.gain: Pricing models worked through end to end on a whiteboard. Older than most things here, and it does not matter: pricing logic does not change the way software interfaces do.

courses.title: When a client says your price is too high, role play
courses.gain: A role play of the exact moment your rate gets pushed back on. Watch this before your first discovery call, right after you practise saying your number out loud.

courses.title: Google Ads Search Certification
courses.gain: The paid-ads credential clients ask for most often. Free from study through to the certificate, no exam fee. Note it expires after about 12 months and you retake it free.

courses.title: Google Analytics 4 Certification
courses.gain: GA4 is the reporting layer behind almost every client dashboard you will be asked to build. Free exam, free certificate, renewed yearly.

courses.title: Gemini for Google Workspace Certification
courses.gain: Using AI inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Drive, which is exactly the stack most executive assistants live in. One of the few free credentials aimed at admin work rather than marketing. Search the Skillshop catalog for the certification by name.

courses.title: Google Workspace Administration Certification
courses.gain: Managing users, shared drives, groups and permissions in Workspace. If you want to be the VA who owns a client's whole Google setup rather than just their inbox, this is the credential for it. Search the Skillshop catalog for the certification by name.

courses.title: Inbound Service Fundamentals
courses.gain: Handling customers properly: the support framework, tone, and turning complaints into retention. Customer support is one of the easiest VA niches to get hired into and this is the clearest free credential for it.

courses.title: HubSpot CRM Certification
courses.gain: Contacts, companies, deals and tickets. CRM hygiene is a task clients hand to a VA early, and this is often listed as a preferred qualification in admin and operations postings.

courses.title: AI for Marketing
courses.gain: Using AI for content, campaigns and personalisation without producing obvious slop. Free certificate, and a credible way to show clients you use these tools deliberately.

courses.title: Digital Marketing Certification
courses.gain: The broad overview: strategy, channels, and how the pieces fit together. Useful if you want one credential that covers the whole field rather than a single channel.

courses.title: Service Hub Software
courses.gain: Help desk, knowledge base and customer feedback tools. The videos and quizzes are free, but be aware the certificate itself needs a paid HubSpot plan, so treat this as learning rather than a credential.

courses.title: SEO Crash Course with Brian Dean
courses.gain: The fastest credible SEO grounding you can get. Fifty minutes from Backlinko's founder, with a free certificate at the end. Do this before any longer SEO course.

courses.title: Keyword Research Essentials
courses.gain: How to find what people actually search for and turn it into a content plan. This is the skill clients pay content VAs for, and the free certificate proves you have it.

courses.title: Local SEO Essentials
courses.gain: Google Business Profiles, local citations and near-me visibility. Most small-business clients care far more about this than national SEO, and few VAs offer it.

courses.title: Meta Social Media Marketing Professional Certificate
courses.gain: Six courses built by Meta: social strategy, content management, ad fundamentals, Meta Ads Manager, measurement, and a capstone. Audit every lesson free. The certificate and the Meta Digital Marketing Associate exam need a paid subscription, though financial aid is available.

courses.title: Advertising with Meta
courses.gain: The single most useful course in the Meta series if you only do one. Structure campaigns in Ads Manager, build an ad against a real objective, and set budget, placement and schedule. Audit is free.

courses.title: Meta Blueprint free courses
courses.gain: Meta's own training for Facebook and Instagram ads, free and current with Ads Manager. Be clear on what is free: the courses are, but the Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate exam costs around $99, so treat this as learning rather than a credential. Needs a Facebook login.

courses.title: Social Media Marketing Certification
courses.gain: Full social strategy: content, community, measurement, listening. Exam-based cert.

courses.title: Free Social Media Marketing Courses
courses.gain: Curated free courses from Coursera covering social media strategy, platform-specific best practices, and analytics. Audit is free.

courses.title: Instagram & Content Strategy (free courses)
courses.gain: Curated free courses on Instagram growth, content pillars, hashtags, and analytics. Audit is free.

courses.title: Instagram Marketing basics (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Udemy has periodic free Instagram courses. Filter by 'Free' in search. No certs on free versions.

courses.title: TikTok Marketing (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Same deal, free TikTok courses rotate in and out on Udemy. Good for bite-sized learning.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Digital Marketing
courses.gain: The gold standard free marketing cert. Globally recognized, looks great on any resume.

courses.title: Inbound Marketing Certification
courses.gain: Content marketing, SEO, lead gen, buyer's journey. The HubSpot cert clients recognize.

courses.title: Email Marketing Certification
courses.gain: Email strategy, segmentation, deliverability, automation. Exam at the end.

courses.title: Content Marketing Certification
courses.gain: Long-form writing, blogging, content strategy, repurposing. Paired well with SMM.

courses.title: SEO Training Certification
courses.gain: SEO fundamentals: keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, technical SEO. Exam-based cert.

courses.title: Email Marketing (free courses)
courses.gain: Browse free email marketing courses covering strategy, automation, segmentation, and deliverability. Audit-only.

courses.title: Off-Page SEO & AI Search Essentials
courses.gain: Modern SEO for 2026, off-page optimization, backlinks, and how to rank in AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

courses.title: Digital Marketing Specialization
courses.gain: 7-course specialization from UVA on digital strategy. Audit is free, cert is paid.

courses.title: Design School. Canva Certified
courses.gain: Canva fundamentals, design principles, branded templates. Quick win for any creative VA.

courses.title: Adobe Express for Creators
courses.gain: Free Adobe design tool, alternative to Canva. Tutorials and guides.

courses.title: Graphic Design Specialization
courses.gain: CalArts specialization covering typography, images, color. Audit is free, cert is paid.

courses.title: Canva courses (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Udemy has rotating free Canva courses. Check the 'Free' filter. Good practice, no cert.

courses.title: Figma for Beginners (free YouTube series)
courses.gain: Figma's own official learning series. The tool every modern design team uses.

courses.title: DaVinci Resolve Training
courses.gain: Free pro video editor training, the tool used in Hollywood. PDF certs available.

courses.title: CapCut & Reels editing (free courses)
courses.gain: The tool every SMM uses for Reels. Browse Udemy's free CapCut and short-form video editing courses.

courses.title: Video Editing courses (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Udemy often has free Premiere, DaVinci, and CapCut intro courses. Rotate in and out.

courses.title: Shopify Academy. All Courses
courses.gain: Free courses across store setup, merchandising, customer experience, and marketing.

courses.title: eCommerce Marketing Certification
courses.gain: Marketing strategy specifically for online stores. Segmentation, lifecycle, retention.

courses.title: Shopify courses (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Rotating free Shopify basics on Udemy. Store setup, product listing, dropshipping.

courses.title: QuickBooks & Bookkeeping (free courses)
courses.gain: Free QuickBooks and bookkeeping fundamentals. Audit-only. Intuit also offers a paid official cert separately.

courses.title: Xero Accounting (free courses)
courses.gain: Browse free Xero courses on Udemy, the other major bookkeeping tool. Great if clients use Xero instead of QB.

courses.title: Bookkeeping Basics
courses.gain: Intuit's Coursera course: accounting equation, debits/credits, financial statements.

courses.title: Bookkeeping basics (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Udemy runs rotating free bookkeeping intros. Good for fundamentals before the certs above.

courses.title: Intercom Academy
courses.gain: Free training on Intercom, live chat, automation, help center building.

courses.title: Asana Academy
courses.gain: Free Asana training + cert. If clients use Asana for PM, this is a resume builder.

courses.title: monday.com tutorial for beginners
courses.gain: Boards, groups, automations and dashboards. Replaces monday.com's own academy, which now bounces every visitor to a sign-in page.

courses.title: Notion Essentials
courses.gain: Databases, relations, templates, formulas. The VA-favorite workspace tool.

courses.title: Zapier Learn. Automation Basics
courses.gain: Build automations between 5000+ apps. In-demand skill that sets you apart from other VAs.

courses.title: ClickUp University
courses.gain: All-in-one workspace training. ClickUp certification available for power users.

courses.title: Responsive Web Design Certification
courses.gain: Real free cert in HTML/CSS from freeCodeCamp. If you want to become a tech VA, start here.

courses.title: Google Project Management (full program)
courses.gain: 6-course specialization on Agile, Scrum, Waterfall. Audit is free, graded cert is paid.

courses.title: Atlassian University. Jira / Confluence
courses.gain: Jira and Confluence training. High-demand for tech teams and dev-adjacent VA work.

courses.title: Agile & Scrum basics (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Udemy often has free Agile/Scrum fundamentals. Good before paid PMI certs.

courses.title: Google AI Essentials
courses.gain: Hands-on AI use for work. Prompting, responsible use, real use cases. Audit is free.

courses.title: ChatGPT Prompt Engineering
courses.gain: Official OpenAI partner course. Prompting techniques that actually work.

courses.title: Claude prompting guides
courses.gain: Official guides on prompting Claude effectively. No formal cert, but essential reading.

courses.title: ChatGPT for business (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Rotating free ChatGPT intro courses on Udemy. Focus on workplace use cases.

courses.title: Copywriting (filter to 'Free')
courses.gain: Udemy has periodic free copywriting intros. Good for fundamentals.

courses.title: Grammarly Business courses
courses.gain: Professional writing fundamentals: grammar, clarity, tone. Free through Grammarly Business.
